candidate_policy.boundary_exception: numeric n=0 may recur as a raw input because it uniquely exercises the empty loop under this schema; it is a new semantic case for a new task and its raw-input reuse is disclosed
candidate_policy.evaluation_case_pool: numeric 0..100; array signed values -16..16; exclude exact accepted training case triples and consumed exact task/case triples; record raw-stdin overlap separately
candidate_policy.evaluation_selection: fixed-seed candidate ordering; first five satisfying each task's positive, zero, overlap, boundary, multiplicity and pairwise-distinguishing matrix; reject task if impossible
candidate_policy.generator: scripts/build_phase3c_conf1_data.py; deterministic from this ledger and construction_seed
candidate_policy.primary_array_cases: prepend all-zero tuple; draw 4096 four-tuples using random.Random(construction_seed), each component -16..16; greedily choose four further tuples maximizing newly distinguished pairs among 120, ties by candidate index; require all 120 pairs, otherwise STOP
candidate_policy.primary_prompt_rule: fixed graph-specific text in prospective builder; no model-based edits
candidate_policy.rejection_log: record every attempted candidate ID, input/prompt/reference hash, and rejection reason before accepting successor
candidate_policy.secondary_cases: reuse the five preselected domain inputs from primary but expected outputs derive from each fresh secondary specification
candidate_policy.selection: first candidate in deterministic order satisfying frozen semantic, case-discrimination, coverage and overlap constraints
candidate_policy.training_array_cases: for each slot use random.Random(SHA256(construction_seed,slot_id,'train-array')) to draw five unique 4-tuples from -16..16, rejection logged; exclude tuples selected for evaluation
candidate_policy.training_case_pool: numeric 0..60; array signed values -16..16; case identity is task specification plus stdin plus expected output
candidate_policy.training_numeric_cases: for each slot use random.Random(SHA256(construction_seed,slot_id,'train-numeric')) to sample five distinct n from 1..60 excluding 12,13,14; sort ascending
candidate_policy.training_prompt_rule: same wrapper; only separate-count versus overlap-count treatment clause differs

NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=0.
NUMBER right=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>i) { left+=1. } }
LOOP (NUMBER j=0 TILL j<4, j++) { IF (values[j]<0) { right+=1. } }
DISPLAYNL(left*right).
